reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows a 40-fold coercivity increase in FeCoNiMnCu after RTA, but explicitly states the film remains a single face-centered-cubic phase, not L1₀. The L1₀ ordering premise is directly contradicted by the cited source, which only observes L1₀ when Pt is added. The mechanism of pinning-controlled coercivity is supported, but the structural mediator is misrepresented.
premises: RTA induces L1₀ ordering in FeCoNiMnCu thin films
Increased anisotropy enhances domain wall pinning
Enhanced domain wall pinning increases coercivity
A ~40-fold coercivity increase is achievable in this system
